digest.component_or_area: external integration testing, live Jira Cloud multi-project reconciliation
propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live test suite for Jira Cloud projects REB and DIG must be added to `tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/` exercising real ticket volume and diversity without any Jira mutations

The test suite must structurally enforce read-only invariants by monkeypatching all mutating AcliClient methods to raise JiraWriteForbidden, ensuring the suite is unable to invoke outbound Jira mutations
Multi-project inbound fetch via `compute_snapshot` with REB+DIG mapping must pull real volume (thousands of issues) with correct per-project attribution, scoped by the projects.json mapping
The `bridge_preview` dry-run mode must remain read-only and per-project scoped with zero outbound Jira mutations, verified by before/after per-project issue count equality
The isolated S3 store backend (throwaway `s3://<bucket>/<unique-prefix>`) must round-trip via git-remote-s3 push and clone while preserving the REB+DIG projects.json mapping
Unknown mapped project keys must fail closed (raise) during fetch, never silently succeed
